pages.description: Experience stunning 4K walking tours from around the world with Prowalk Tours. Explore historic cities, scenic landscapes, and cultural landmarks—no passport required. Watch full-length, immersive tours on YouTube and discover new destinations from the comfort of your home.

pages.text: Welcome to Prowalk Tours! Experience breathtaking 4K walking tours from around the world. Explore historic streets, famous landmarks, and hidden gems—all from the comfort of your home. Watch our full tours on YouTube and start your virtual journey today! Watch Our Newest Tour Browse by Year Explore Our Filming Gear Our footage has been licensed and used on shows like the German “Who Wants to Be a Millionaire” and USA’s “History Channel”. Learn more. ProWalk Tours offers a unique experience for our viewers and sponsors. We are a consistent, growing and ready to help. Learn more. Viewer support makes our videos possible. Choose a YouTube membership, become a Patreon member, or give via PayPal. Support here. We are constantly looking for ambitious walkers. Do you have a love for travel and the skills to contribute to the PWT team? Learn more. Join us here. I recently did a interview with Grant Ball on his Video Creatr Podcast. Here is a link to the episode if you are interested in hearing a little background information on the Prowalk Tours channel and the man behind the camera.

Italy , Campania , Pompeii , 2017 , • 3/12/17 Pompeii Walking Tour Pompeii Walking Tour - with Music Italy , Campania , Naples , 2017 , • 7/1/17 The Spanish Quarter of Naples, Italy Take a walk through busy narrow streets of the Spanish Quarters in Naples, Italy. Built in the 1600's to house the Spanish troops, this area, also known as the Casbah to many Neapolitans, is now home to roughly 14,000 residents. These streets are the first example of modern urban planning in Europe as they are a grid network of around eighteen streets by twelve. Italy , Amalfi Coast , Hike , 2017 , • 6/17/17 Path of the Gods - East to West This walking tour of the Path of the Gods was filmed on July 1st, 2017. Italy , Amalfi Coast , Campania , Naples , 2017 , Hike , • 6/17/17 Path of the Gods - West to East Walk West to East on the Path of the Gods in this virtual walk. Admire one of the most beautiful panoramas on earth as you hike 500 meters above the sea from Nocelle towards Bomerano. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 7/8/17 Sant'Agata de' Goti Walking Tour Sant'Agata de' Goti is a small hill town in the Italian region of Campania. The historic town, founded in 313BC, is built on a raised bluff and the residences are built right on the edge above the river gorge. Wander the tight, winding streets of this charming medieval village and experience the fascinating blend of the old and the new. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 7/29/17 Paestum, Italy Virtual Walking Tour Walk through the ruins of the ancient Greek city of Paestum. The ruins include three ancient Greek temples dating from 600 to 450 BC. The entire city covered almost 300 acres of which only 60 acres has been excavated. Paris , 2017 , • 8/5/17 Paris, France Walking Tour (with Music) This walking tour of Paris, France was filmed on Saturday August 5th, 2017 starting 5pm at the Louvre. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 8/12/17 Caserta Palace Virtual Walking Tour (World Heritage Site) This walking tour of the Caserta Palace was filmed on Saturday August 12th, 2017. The Royal Palace of Caserta is the former royal residence for the Bourbon kings of Naples. It is one of the largest royal residences in the world. In 1999 it was used as the setting for Queen Amidala's palace on Naboo in the film Star Wars: Episode 1. Inside you'll find the Grand Staircase of Honour and room after room of history. Outside you'll walk a 2 mile long park surrounded by statues, trees, pools, and fountains. Paris , 2017 , • 8/5/17 Paris, France Walking Tour This walk of Paris, France was filmed on August 5th, 2017 starting at 5pm at the Louvre. Take a 12 mile (19 km) walk through the streets of Paris and see the Louvre, Notre Dame, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, the Eiffel Tower, and more. Italy , Campania , Hike , 2017 , • 8/14/17 Mt. Vesuvius Walking Tour This hike up Mt. Vesuvius was filmed on August 14th, 2017 starting at 10 am. The eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79 destroyed the Roman cities of Pompeii, Herculaneum, Oplontis, Stabiae, and several other settlements. Italy , Campania , Naples , 2017 , • 8/17/17 Procida, Italy Walking Tour This walk around the island of Procida was filmed on Thursday August 17th, 2017. Procida is a volcanic island located in Gulf of Naples in the Campania region of Italy. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 9/9/17 Roman Amphitheater Tour - Pozzuoli, Italy - 4K This walk of the Roman Amphiteater in Pozzuoli, Italy was filmed on Saturday September 9th, 2017. Take a walk through the underground passageways and over the arena floor of the Flavian Amphitheater in Pozzuoli, Italy. It is the third largest amphitheater in Italy, behind the Roman Colosseum and the Amphitheater in Capua. When it was excavated in the 19th century, archaeologists discovered that much of the Flavian Amphitheater's structure was still intact and it's underground extremely well preserved. Italy , Rome , Lazio Region , Ruins , 2017 , • 9/23/17 Roman Forum Walking Tour in 4K Roman Forum Walking Tour - 2017 Italy , Rome , Lazio Region , Ruins , 2017 , • 9/23/17 Roman Forum Guided Tour - Narrated by Official Tour Guide Tour of the Roman Forum with narration from an official tour guide of Rome! Italy , Rome , Lazio Region , Naples , 2017 , • 9/23/17 Colosseum Walking Tour in 4k This walking tour of the Colosseum was filmed on September 23rd, 2017 starting at 9:00 am at the Colosseo Metro stop. In this walk you see all 4 levels including the arena floor and the infamous underground, the Hypogeum. For the best experience, be sure to wear headphones 🎧 as you watch this tour. Italy , Campania , Ruins , 2017 , • 9/26/17 Roman Amphitheater Tour - Capua, Italy - 4K This tour of the Roman Amphitheater in Capua was filmed on September 26th, 2017. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 9/30/17 Pozzuoli, Italy Walking Tour - 4K This walking tour of Pozzuoli, Italy was filmed on Saturday September 30th, 2017. Pozzuoli is a modern city with an ancient past. It was founded by the Greeks in 529 BC and then taken over by the Romans in 194 BC who renamed it Puteoli (Pozzuoli). Italy , Campania , Ruins , 2017 , • 9/26/17 Roman Amphitheater Tour - Capua, Italy - 4K This tour of the Roman Amphitheater in Capua was filmed on September 26th, 2017. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 9/9/17 Roman Amphitheater Tour - Pozzuoli, Italy - 4K This walk of the Roman Amphiteater in Pozzuoli, Italy was filmed on Saturday September 9th, 2017. Take a walk through the underground passageways and over the arena floor of the Flavian Amphitheater in Pozzuoli, Italy. It is the third largest amphitheater in Italy, behind the Roman Colosseum and the Amphitheater in Capua. When it was excavated in the 19th century, archaeologists discovered that much of the Flavian Amphitheater's structure was still intact and it's underground extremely well preserved. Vesuvius was filmed on August 14th, 2017 starting at 10 am. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 8/12/17 Caserta Palace Virtual Walking Tour (World Heritage Site) This walking tour of the Caserta Palace was filmed on Saturday August 12th, 2017. The Royal Palace of Caserta is the former royal residence for the Bourbon kings of Naples. It is one of the largest royal residences in the world. In 1999 it was used as the setting for Queen Amidala's palace on Naboo in the film Star Wars: Episode 1. Inside you'll find the Grand Staircase of Honour and room after room of history. Outside you'll walk a 2 mile long park surrounded by statues, trees, pools, and fountains. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 7/29/17 Paestum, Italy Virtual Walking Tour Walk through the ruins of the ancient Greek city of Paestum. The ruins include three ancient Greek temples dating from 600 to 450 BC. The entire city covered almost 300 acres of which only 60 acres has been excavated. Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 7/8/17 Sant'Agata de' Goti Walking Tour Sant'Agata de' Goti is a small hill town in the Italian region of Campania. The historic town, founded in 313BC, is built on a raised bluff and the residences are built right on the edge above the river gorge. Wander the tight, winding streets of this charming medieval village and experience the fascinating blend of the old and the new. These streets are the first example of modern urban planning in Europe as they are a grid network of around eighteen streets by twelve. pages.text: Italy , Campania , Pompeii , 2017 , • 3/12/17 Pompeii Walking Tour Take a 2-hour walk around the ruins of Pompeii. Pompeii is located near the Bay of Naples. It was destroyed in 79 A.D. when Mt. Vesuvius erupted and covered the city in a blanket of ash. While most Pompeiians had time to flee, over 2,000 people died. Pompeii was rediscovered in 1758 by a group of explorers. The excavation process continues to this today with one-third of the city still waiting to be unearthed. Now the city acts as a window into the ancient past. You can see the streets, buildings, houses and even the remains of the victims, just as they were almost 2,000 years ago. pages.text: Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 9/9/17 Roman Amphitheater Tour - Pozzuoli, Italy - 4K This walk of the Roman Amphiteater in Pozzuoli, Italy was filmed on Saturday September 9th, 2017. Take a walk through the underground passageways and over the arena floor of the Flavian Amphitheater in Pozzuoli, Italy. It is the third largest amphitheater in Italy, behind the Roman Colosseum and the Amphitheater in Capua. When it was excavated in the 19th century, archaeologists discovered that much of the Flavian Amphitheater's structure was still intact and it's underground extremely well preserved. Wander the tight, winding streets of this charming medieval village and experience the fascinating blend of the old and the new. pages.text: Italy , Campania , 2017 , • 8/12/17 Caserta Palace Virtual Walking Tour (World Heritage Site) This walking tour of the Caserta Palace was filmed on Saturday August 12th, 2017. The Royal Palace of Caserta is the former royal residence for the Bourbon kings of Naples. It is one of the largest royal residences in the world. In 1999 it was used as the setting for Queen Amidala's palace on Naboo in the film Star Wars: Episode 1. Inside you'll find the Grand Staircase of Honour and room after room of history. Outside you'll walk a 2 mile long park surrounded by statues, trees, pools, and fountains. Italy , 2018 , • 11/10/18 Civita di Bagnoregio Walking Tour - The Dying City Civita di Bagnoregio is one of the most striking medieval towns in all of Italy perched high up on a volcanic rock. The ancient Etruscan people chose this site for its high ground in the 6th Century BC. Over the centuries, earthquakes and erosion have caused parts of Civita to collapse into the valley below, giving it the nickname The Dying City. pages.text: Italy , Islands , 2018 , Capri , • 10/14/18 Capri Walking Tour 6 - The Gardens of Augustus and Charterhouse of San Giacomo in 4K This walked was filmed on October 14th, 2018 between 10:15am and 12:05pm. The walk begins at the Belvedere of the Piazzetta where you walk through the Piazzetta and past the Quisisana Hotel before reaching the Hotel Luna grounds. Before reaching the Gardens of Augustus, you will walk past the famous perfume shop, Carthusia. The walk continues to one of the oldest buildings on the island, the Charterhouse of San Giacomo, i.e., the Certosa di San Giacomo. This is where the Carthusian monks lived in silence and solitude. Enjoy! pages.text: Italy , 2018 , • 11/10/18 Civita di Bagnoregio Walking Tour - The Dying City Civita di Bagnoregio is one of the most striking medieval towns in all of Italy perched high up on a volcanic rock. The ancient Etruscan people chose this site for its high ground in the 6th Century BC. Over the centuries, earthquakes and erosion have caused parts of Civita to collapse into the valley below, giving it the nickname The Dying City. pages.text: Capri , 2019 , Italy , • 4/9/19 Capri Walking Tour 4 - The Pizzolungo Trail and the Natural Arch This walk was filmed on October 12th, 2018 and April 9th, 2019. The walk begins at the Belvedere Tragara and then continues along the Pizzolungo Trail with scenic views out over the Faraglioni Rocks. Before reaching the Natural Arch, you will see the Grotta di Matermania, a natural cave used as a Nympheum by the Romans. Finally, towards the end of the walk you will see the Arco Naturale, or Natural Arch. Enjoy! pages.text: Egypt , • 1/20/19 Cairo's Khan el-Khalili Walking Tour (4K/60fps) WALKING IN CAIRO: This was filmed on January 20th, 2019 starting at 1:30pm. The walk begins on Muizz streets and then turns into the Khan el-Khalili market. After weaving in out of the market, the walk continues up Muizz street and passed several famous Islamic landmarks. The camera was not allowed inside most of them. Let's go for a walk! The hot springs and have become increasingly popular with tourists as more and more pictures of the falls get posted up on social media.

pages.title: About | Explore The World Virtually Today — Prowalk Tours
pages.description: Discover immersive walking tours from around the world with Prowalk Tours. Join us for detailed, scenic videos and support our channel to enhance your virtual travel experiences.
headings: About Prowalk Tours
The FIRST Camera Setup
Camera Setup 2.0 - The Gopro
Camera Setup 3.0 - The Sony
pages.text: About Prowalk Tours Ciao, I’m Isaac, aka Ike. My family and I moved to Italy in 2014 after I got a job with DoDEA as a high school math teacher. Prowalk Tours began with a request from my uncle Knut. He asked me to film a walk of Naples, Italy that he could watch while he walked on his treadmill. I filmed the first walking tour of Naples on February 11th, 2017 and posted it to YouTube just 3 days later. Prowalk Tours was born and became the first walking tour channel on YouTube! After one year, the channel had gained 1,300 subscribers with a total of 83,000 views. Now, almost 6 years later, the channel has over half a million subscribers and over 170 Million views! Each day, the channel gets between 3 and 5 YEARS of watch time! I appreciate the time that you take to watch the videos, comment and reach out to me. The support is truly mind-blowing. If you find value in our work and would like to support us you can do so monthly through our Patreon or by becoming a YouTube Member where you will get special deals with our sponsors and other ProWalk insider benefits. Thanks again and happy walking! — Isaac The FIRST Camera Setup This was my original camera setup that I used while filming the first walking tour of Naples, Italy back in 2017. My goal was to film a fast paced walk that viewers could watch on their treadmill. I got a LOT of bewildered looks from the people of Naples as I walked down the streets. Camera Setup 2.0 - The Gopro This is the setup I used to film all my tours from 2018 to 2022. I figured out that holding the camera and gimbal on a selfie-stick allowed me to absorb most of the bounce while walking, and it also allowed me to look around. I was also able to extend the selfie-stick so I could easily film over crowds and through fences. Camera Setup 3.0 - The Sony
